content: {"episode_id":"ep-05122","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-50 determination that CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, was not medically necessary. The clinical indication note documents a patient with a history of atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10) who reports intermittent episodes of palpitations (R00.2) accompanied by dizziness and giddiness (R42). Per the ordering note, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess for ischemic changes in the context of known coronary artery disease. These documented indications meet the clinical criteria for this diagnostic modality, and we request reconsideration and payment of the outstanding balance of 495.93."}
